document.title: Form PENS.S/1 — Signature Specimen of Participant, Retiree or Beneficiary

chunks.part: Form PENS.S/1 — Signature Specimen of Participant, Retiree or Beneficiary
chunks.heading: What form PENS.S/1 is used for
chunks.text: Form PENS.S/1 registers the signature of a participant, retiree or beneficiary with UNJSPF. Having a signature on file may reduce the time needed to process benefit payments.

chunks.part: Form PENS.S/1 — Signature Specimen of Participant, Retiree or Beneficiary
chunks.heading: Sections on form PENS.S/1
chunks.text: Section 1 - Participant, retiree or beneficiary information (UID, pension number, retirement number, date of birth, name, address, contact details); Section 2 - Acknowledgement and signature specimen; Section 3 - Signature authentication.

chunks.part: Form PENS.S/1 — Signature Specimen of Participant, Retiree or Beneficiary
chunks.heading: Signature authentication requirement on form PENS.S/1
chunks.text: The form must be signed in the presence of a United Nations official, government official or notary public, who certifies the signature by completing Section 3. UNJSPF retains the signature on file for verification; all future signatures provided must match the authenticated specimen, and a new form must be submitted if the signature changes.
